value.text: Three weeks of rain and the shed roof has finally told us where it leaks.
Slides from last night are here, along with the three questions I could not answer.
Notes from the river survey are up. Fewer snails than last year, more mayflies.
We have a new microscope on loan. It is older than all of us and works better.

A short thread on the repair café numbers from this year.
412 things came in. 301 went home working.
Lamps were the most common. Toasters were the most stubborn.
